scope: Complete PointSampling recipe family: descriptor and typed form, metadata preflight, existing Stepwise/fs2 execution, built-in stamped plan/result codecs, generic manifest roles and registration, one result-table layer, codec laws/fixtures and common family witness. Epoch component and keyed errors are reviewed dependencies with their own receipts.

contract.forms: Eight editable fields; exact signed64 query/bin instants and bottom-k seed, both endpoint policies, explicit controls and nested reduction policies. Context supplies timeline, layout and scientific input.
contract.preflight: Combined scanpath/template content reference; shared matching logic retains focal keys and nominal template keys for deterministic matched clock/frame refusals. Data failures are warnings; absent/wrong input is blocking. No density normalization or point lookup in preflight.
contract.result_stamp: SHA256 canonical complete embedded plan used for both plan and embedded-input claims; missing/stale stamp refused before numerical replay. Valid-stamp saved values must match deterministic replay.
contract.completed_result: PointSamplingArchive.completed binds existing input/plan/provenance identities and row/query metadata without rerunning sampling; it retains the same result object.
contract.legacy: Existing caller-defined conditional v1 plan/archive payload and R sampling fixtures are unchanged.
contract.tables: Legacy and stamped overloads share the same points table implementation; stamped route retains its archive in context. No second table abstraction.
contract.execution: One whole-study preparation, then quantum-bounded batches of whole focal trials; cancellation between operations only.
contract.family_mapping: PointSampling now maps to RecipeFamily.PointSampling and leaves the explicit withoutFamily allowlist. Epochs remain a component, with no analysis role.

verification.canonical_oracle: Independent Python tagged binary canonical renderer, including insertion-ordered objects, UTF16 strings and binary64 numbers. Both runtime encoders match the pinned stamp and fixtures.

mutation.mutation: decode every template normalization as None

landing_status: Reviewed family slice awaiting combined qualification and landing. S5 parent remains open until all reviewed slices land.
